    "text": "Core loop: the player controls a single fighter character who can move and throw a punch attack at a stationary training dummy. The dummy is invulnerable/indestructible for this prototype — it does not take damage, lose health, or die; it exists purely as a hit-registration target. Punch attacks have a short cooldown/animation-lock to prevent spam-registering multiple hits per single swing (one hit credited per successful strike animation). Basic movement (walk/strafe) lets the player reposition around the dummy to re-approach for the next punch.
